symbols.name: Command
symbols.markdown:
一条命令。在MCFPP编译过程中，一条命令可能会被分为多个命令片段，由接口`ICommandPart`实现。一个`Command`对象可以包含多个`CommandPart`对象。命令中的片段可以被字符串标签标记，从而能够对命令的某些片段进行替换操作。

要开始构建一个命令，可以使用`Command`的伴随对象中的`Command.build`方法，或者使用`Command(String)`构造函数。此后，可以继续通过链式调用成员方法`build(String)`或者`build(Command)`来添加命令片段，或者使用`build(command:String, pointID: String)`来在添加命令片段的同时，标记该片段的替换标签为`pointID`。

对于宏命令而言，可以使用成员方法`buildMacro(id: Var<*>)`来构建一个宏命令，其中`id`代表的变量就是要传递给宏的变量。随后，构建出的宏命令需要再使用`buildMacroFunction`方法将宏命令转换为宏函数来调用，从而提高宏命令的效率。此方法将会返回一个新的`Command`对象，即调用此宏函数的命令。

要替换命令中的一些片段，可以使用成员方法`replace(pointID: String, target: String)`或者`replace(pointID: String, target: Command)`。它将会把标记为`pointID`的片段替换为`target`。

symbols.name: ApiVersion
symbols.markdown:
The version of the public MNI API, tracked separately from compiler releases.

This version covers `top.mcfpp.mni.api`, `@MNIMacro`, and explicit macro declarations in MCFPP source.
During the experimental 0.x series, a minor version change may require provider changes.

A Kotlin provider can check its required version during initialization:

```kotlin
require(ApiVersion.isCompatibleWith("0.2")) { "Provider requires MNI API 0.2" }
```

See `docs/mni/api-versioning.md` for the compatibility policy.

symbols.name: MAJOR
symbols.markdown: Major API version. Zero identifies the experimental series.

symbols.name: MINOR
symbols.markdown: Minor API version. In the 0.x series, providers require the same minor version.

symbols.name: PATCH
symbols.markdown: Patch API version for compatible corrections within this minor version.

symbols.name: STABILITY
symbols.markdown: Release channel appended to [VERSION].

symbols.name: VERSION
symbols.markdown: Full identifier, for example `0.2.0-experimental`.

symbols.name: EXPERIMENTAL
symbols.markdown: Convenience flag for providers that branch on the experimental contract.

symbols.name: current
symbols.markdown: The version implemented by this compiler build.

symbols.name: isCompatibleWith
symbols.markdown:
True when a provider requiring [required] can run on this API.

[required] accepts `major.minor` or `major.minor.patch`, with an optional suffix such as `-experimental`.
An omitted patch means zero. The comparison uses the numeric components.
In the 0.x series, major and minor must match, and the current patch must meet the required patch.
From 1.0, a newer minor also satisfies an older required minor within the same major.
Returns false for malformed versions or negative components.
